document.title: Microwave Plasma Source, Microwave Plasma Processing Apparatus and Plasma Processing Method
document.relationship: Divisional of US application 15/882,028, now US11056317

findings.finding: Conventional reflection-wave and tuner-position monitoring may miss unexpected matching or micro-discharge in the antenna path.
A thermocouple is placed through the coaxial inner conductor so its measurement point is near connector 70 and cap 72 close to slot antenna 62.
The example uses a warning above 150 C for at least 2 seconds and an alarm above 300 C for at least 2 seconds.
At 3.0 kW, Ant-2 reached 162.7 C, above the 150 C warning threshold, and later showed abnormal discharge evidence.
Temperature is used as a leading indicator for ignition failure, complementing conventional microwave parameter monitoring.
The disclosed experiment alone does not establish false-positive rate, sensor response across other tools, or a universal threshold.
findings.source: Analyst assessment based on the limited experiment in PDF p.15
